newsitem.title: USA: Olympic unit files $4.0 bln shelf debt.
newsitem.headline: Olympic unit files $4.0 bln shelf debt.

text.p: Olympic Receivables Finance Corp, a unit of Olympic Financial Ltd, filed a shelf registration Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $4.0 billion in asset-backed securities.
The securities to be offered -- certificates and notes backed by automobile receivables -- will be issued by a trust formed by the financing company.

The trust's assets include a pool of retail installment sales contracts and promissory notes purchased by Olympic Financial from car dealers and secured by new and used cars and light trucks and amounts paid or payable for those vehicles.

Net proceeds will be used by Olympic Receivables to buy automobile financing receivables from Olympic Financial, which in turn will use funds to pay warehouse loans. Any additional proceeds will be added to Olympic Financial's general funds and used for its general corporate purposes.
Olympic Receivables is based in Minneapolis, Minn.
